name: Lukas Hoffmann
headline: Lead Backend Engineer
summary: Lead Backend Engineer with 11 years of experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments. Proven track record leading engineering teams, architecting microservices, and driving Kubernetes and AWS adoption across organizations. Passionate about mentoring engineers and building resilient, high-throughput backend platforms.

responsibilities: Lead a team of 8 backend engineers building microservices for a fintech payments platform
Define technical roadmap and architecture standards across backend teams
Drove migration from monolithic architecture to Kubernetes-based microservices on AWS
Established CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time by half
Mentor mid-level and senior engineers through code reviews and design sessions
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for a logistics tracking platform
Optimized PostgreSQL queries and database schema for high-volume transactions
Introduced containerization using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
Collaborated with DevOps to migrate infrastructure to AWS
Developed backend services for an e-commerce order management system
Implemented messaging queues to handle asynchronous order processing
Participated in on-call rotation and incident resolution
Wrote unit and integration tests to improve code reliability
Assisted in development of internal tooling for a mid-sized software team
Fixed bugs and implemented small features under senior developer guidance
